_schema: Ingredient rows (part 1 of 2; the renderer merges gdd/data/ingredients*.json). Fields: id (ING_), name, tags (canon C9 vocabulary only), group (BRD MEA SEA DAI VEG FRU GRN SAU SPC SWT LIQ GRS ALN MUT LEG), cost (MB per unit), unlock (level), storage (STN_PANTRY | STN_FRIDGE | STN_FREEZER), actions (canon C8 state-changing actions this ingredient accepts; prep states are derived), look (visual brief; asset key derived as ing_<name>), crate (units per crate, SPECIAL only; crate price = crate x cost), count ([units per qty, label, optional state] for countable components, §5.4.9). Supply is derived: SPECIAL if tagged alien/mutagen/legendary/gold/glowing or unlock > 20, else BASIC.
